entities.summary: Lieutenant-Colonel Charles-Michel d'Irumberry de Salaberry, CB was a Canadian military officer and politician who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars and War of 1812. He is best known for repelling an American invasion of Quebec at the Battle of the Chateauguay.
